title: Get a permit for outdoor dining on the footpath
what: Get the council's permit before setting up or running an outdoor eating area on a footpath or other public place.

laws.title: City of Bunbury Public Places and Local Government Property Local Law 2020

sources.title: City of Bunbury Public Places and Local Government Property Local Law 2020
sources.locator: cl 8.3(1), as made, Gazette No. 177, 20 Oct 2020
sources.quote: No person shall set up or conduct an alfresco dining area in a street or public place—

confidence_note: Quotes the local law as made, from the WA Government Gazette; WA publishes no consolidated local laws. The clause was found by a pattern search of every Gazette from 1996 to 2026 (E-8), and the law was taken as in force because no later repeal naming it was found. Amended later (Gazette No. 200, 30 Nov 2021); the amendments were not read.

assessment.summary: Using the footpath for outdoor dining needs the council's permit, with fees and conditions.

marks.reason: A permit, fees and conditions to trade on the footpath.
